meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: When lysosomes are stressed, ULK1 (or its relative TBK1) phosphorylates FNIP1 at S296 on the lysosome. This switches the FLCN-FNIP complex off, so mTORC1 can no longer hold TFEB in the cytoplasm and TFEB moves into the nucleus.
data.mechanism_beginner: ULK1 tags FNIP1, which turns FLCN off and lets TFEB escape mTORC1's grip.
data.boundary: Human cell lines and ATP6V1B2-mutant follicular lymphoma samples; a nutrient-independent lysosomal-stress route, and TBK1 can substitute for ULK1. Single study.
